office.source: OpenAI built-in image_gen, generated fictional office photograph
office.final_prompt: Change ONLY the camera viewpoint and framing of this busy retro office photograph to a convincing high-corner CCTV viewpoint. The camera is mounted at the ceiling corner and looks DOWN at a steep 50-degree angle across the office cubicle grid. NO CEILING is visible at all: the frame is filled by desk surfaces, chair backs, tops of cubicle dividers, people's heads and shoulders, and walkways seen from above. Keep the 1980s/early 1990s office, beige CRT computers, busy workers, desaturated natural colors, soft archival photographic quality. Include at least 8 visible human coworkers across the cubicle rows, with a few standing and walking. 2:3 portrait framing. It must feel like an unobtrusive security camera observing the whole busy room from very high up, not a camera at human eye level. Photographic, no cartoon, no CGI. No timestamp or CCTV interface, no words, no letters, no border, no watermark, no baked-in dither.
